words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجَوَارِ}} ({{tr:al-jawāri}}) does not open a new subject in 81:16; it continues the carried oath description that began with the prior retreating descriptor (81:15). Its definite oblique plural shape lets the known oath class be named by motion rather than by an exposed substance noun. The root pressure narrows here to directed coursing: the reader sees a traceable course, with vessel-like or body-like motion left deliberately under-specified, before {{ar:ٱلْكُنَّسِ}} ({{tr:al-kunnasi}}) supplies the hidden endpoint. Because the word is nominal and participial-like, motion becomes an identifying trait rather than a timed report, unlike finite verbal motion elsewhere (36:38). The same course-motion also prepares the adjacent oath sequence to keep moving through night (81:17) and morning (81:18), so motion changes frame rather than stopping with this pair. The accepted final-vowel reading can let the sound of the word linger into the next descriptor, but it does not change the referent; it only makes the move from open coursing to compressed concealment more audible.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكُنَّسِ}} ({{tr:al-kunnasi}}) is the second descriptor in the same carried oath chain, not a fresh coordinated class. After {{ar:ٱلْجَوَارِ}} ({{tr:al-jawāri}}) has made the referents visible through course-motion, this compact plural lands the phrase in withdrawal from sight. The root evidence allows both clearing-from-view and entering-cover pressure, and the local order narrows those images into a hidden endpoint after motion rather than a separate sweeping scene. Its closeness to the prior retreating descriptor (81:15) matters: the sound-near handoff refines broad recession into cover-directed disappearance. Because the root is Quranically singular in the supplied evidence, the word leans heavily on its immediate pair, its final position, and its dense doubled sound to carry the interpretive weight of closure. That closure also points forward: the next oath keeps hiddenness onstage by moving into night (81:17).

topics.reason: The word closes the ayah after {{ar:ٱلْجَوَارِ}} ({{tr:al-jawāri}}), and the local phrase has no finite verb, so the paired descriptors themselves carry the inferred action.

topics.headline: retreat refined into cover

topics.reason: The boundary from {{ar:ٱلْخُنَّسِ}} ({{tr:al-khunnasi}}) (81:15) to {{ar:ٱلْكُنَّسِ}} ({{tr:al-kunnasi}}) is not merely repetition; the root shift licenses refinement from recession to hidden cover.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Running celestial bodies enter hidden stations.** `ج ر ي` B001 supplies running, flowing, and the sun or ships coursing; `ك ن س` B003 supplies celestial bodies withdrawing into hidden stations. In apposition to the withdrawing bodies of 81:15, the two participles form a visible-course/hidden-station cycle. I infer that concealment belongs to their route rather than interrupting it. The phrase reads as disciplined circulation.
2. **Running animals seek covered lairs.** `ك ن س` B002 supplies an animal entering a hidden shelter, while `ج ر ي` B001 supplies animal running. The wild creatures gathered in 81:5 activate this terrestrial image. I infer an animal simile for the same movement named in 81:15. The phrase simultaneously evokes bodies coursing openly and disappearing into cover.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Seeing at the clear horizon in 81:23 strengthened the celestial reading of B003: a body can cross the visible field and then enter a hidden station. The later sight report made visibility itself part of the course, not a static property.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Moving bodies model authorized envoys returning to stations.** `ج ر ي` `B003` supplies an agent or envoy running in an affair, while `ك ن س` `B003` supplies celestial bodies withdrawing into hidden stations. The message-bearing `رَسُول` of 81:19 is then described as strong, stationed, obeyed, and trustworthy in 81:20-21. Agency gives the runners a commissioned role; hidden stations give them an ordered point of return. My abductive move is analogical: the celestial course models a transmission chain rather than literally carrying the speech. The ayah therefore anticipates the messenger as a mobile agent whose movement remains governed by station and charge.

2. **Their running also sweeps the field clear.** `ج ر ي` `B001` supplies flowing or running, including celestial motion, and `ك ن س` `B001` supplies sweeping a surface clear. The stripped sky of 81:11 and the opening dawn of 81:18 activate the surface-clearing image. Motion supplies the means; sweeping supplies the result. My abductive move is that the runners' passage clears obscurity from the visible field, an effect not explicitly stated. Alongside their hiding, the bodies can thus be read as agents of disclosure: they withdraw into cover yet also clear the scene through which the message becomes legible.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `رَسُول` in 81:19 unexpectedly activated `ج ر ي` `B003`'s envoy branch in the fixed runners. The messenger's station, obedience, and trust in 81:20-21 then confirmed that their motion is commissioned rather than free-floating.

Koşan hayvanların kapalı inlerine sığınması, aynı göksel hareketi yeryüzüne ait canlı bir barınma imgesiyle anlatır.
Koşanların görevli elçiler gibi hareket edip belirlenmiş duraklara dönmesi, sonraki haberci zincirine göksel bir hareket modeli sağlar.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Celestial visibility changes through wrapping, falling, retreat, darkness, exposure, and renewed light.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The celestial sequence extends into hiding places, lamps, constellations, and an overhead canopy physically peeled away.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Planets Retreating into Stations
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Moving celestial bodies withdraw from sight and enter their concealed lodgings.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: planets that hide or reverse (`خ ن س:B002/m01`); celestial running (`ج ر ي:B001/m01`); stars hidden in their courses (`ك ن س:B003/m01`); disappearance from sight (`غ ي ب:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Running, retreat, and entry into a hidden station form one astronomical cycle rather than three unrelated motions.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kendi yolu boyunca akarak, koşarak ya da düzenli biçimde ilerlemesidir. Su, at, rüzgar, güneş ve gemi bu hareketin ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir; gemi ile güneşin hareketlerine dayalı adlandırmaları çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir varlık kendi yolu boyunca akar, koşar ya da kesintisiz biçimde ilerler.
Su ve rüzgar akarak, at koşarak, güneş ile gemi ise izledikleri yol boyunca ilerleyerek çekirdeği gerçekleştirir.
Hareket eden gemi ve gökte ilerleyen güneş, bu ilerleme özellikleri üzerinden ayrıca adlandırılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, bir şeyin yatağında ya da izlediği yolda ilerlemesidir. Hızlı geçiş, suyun akışı, atın koşması, rüzgarın esip gitmesi, güneşin gökte yol alması ve geminin denizde ilerlemesi bu ortak çekirdeğin kapsamındadır.

Gizlenme yeri, batış noktası, görünmezlik konumu veya göksel bir durak olarak farklı biçimlerde betimlenir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilen komşular tüysüzlük, genel yüzey düzgünlüğü, izsizlik ve yağla parlaklaştırma sınırlarını gösterir. Kalan adaylar yalnızca saç, yol veya başka nesne çağrışımları taşıdığı için bu dar niteliğe yararlı bir karşıtlık eklemez.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه وصف الفرس أو الفرسن بالمكنوسة، أي الملساء الجرداء من الشعر أو الملساء الباطن.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس فعلا من كنس البيت، ولا كناس الوحش، ولا كنوس النجوم، ولا أسماء الكنيسة أو النبات أو الموضع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: فرس مكنوسة أي ملساء جرداء من الشعر (ayn)؛ الفرسن المكنوسة الملساء الباطن تشبهها العرب بالمرايا لملاستها (tahdhib)

word_morpheme_spans.note: word_analysis critical words are orthographic/analytic units, not QAC words; each resolves to a MORPHEME SPAN. The upstream aligned_qac_word_ref is preserved verbatim in word_analysis and is NOT corrected here -- renumbering would fabricate identities (PRINCIPLES.md §11 / basmalah no-hidden-renumbering rule). Use word_morpheme_spans for any word-level join to QAC.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: aligned_qac_word_ref resolves against qac_morphemes for this ayah

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_focus_trace_hermetic.note: Hermetic Focus Trace not requested for this bundle. Rebuild with --include-focus-trace, or --require-focus-trace when reader JSON must be present.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.
